title: Edit content.es.json first, then test:i18n, translate only the named paths, i18n:lock, and commit all three files together
body:
1. Edit content/data/content.es.json (preferably via `pnpm run editor`). Never write a fact into content.en.json first.
2. `pnpm run test:i18n` — it names every path whose Spanish no longer matches the lock: exactly what changed.
3. Translate those paths, and only those, in content/data/content.en.json.
4. `pnpm run i18n:lock` — re-stamps the lock to the CURRENT Spanish.
5. Commit content.es.json, content.en.json and content/data/translation.lock.json in ONE commit. A commit with the Spanish change alone ships a stale English CV.
A reviewer runs step 2 on a dataset PR: green means English accounted for everything Spanish moved. If the change touches visible card text, also run `pnpm run og:local` and commit its artifacts.
not_derivable: The ordered loop and the one-commit rule are a workflow; no script encodes the sequence.

evidence.summary: Tracked-path, structural, missing and stale-translation failures.
